title: A tier with two rule types is saved as multiple rules
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, two ranges, pricing one new category made for this test, tier A on Margin % 30 in both ranges.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Click the % symbol picker in tier A's last range.
  5. Pick + $ in that symbol picker.
  6. Type 20 in tier A's last range.
  7. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens in view.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit, with Cancel and Save.

Step 4:

  • A small picker opens on the cell with + $, Markup % and Margin %.

Step 5:

  • Only tier A's last range changes to + $, with an empty value; the first range keeps Margin % 30.

Step 6:

  • Tier A's last range reads 20 with a $ before it.

Step 7:

  • A message reads matrix A's name followed by "saved", with "Parts already on work orders keep their prices."
  • In it, tier A's change reads tier A's name followed by "is multiple rules".
  • Under it, one bullet per rule type: "+ $" and "Margin %".
  • The grid returns to view.
